inventory.label: Billing, payments and financial controls
inventory.limitations: Payment/legal/ledger authority cannot be inferred from a website feature.

inventory.label: Privacy, consent and data-use controls
inventory.limitations: A policy reference is not a conformance certificate.

inventory.label: Service secrets and credential lifecycle
inventory.limitations: Secret Broker owns secret references, not user identity, MFA or access policy.

inventory.label: Reputational monitoring and intervention
inventory.limitations: Brand effect is an analytic projection, not authoritative external reputation truth.

inventory.label: Case and workflow coordination
inventory.limitations: Relationship Case coordinates durable work, not legal conclusions or source-domain records.

inventory.label: Authorisation and delegated access
inventory.limitations: A successful login is not authorisation; local enforcement requires its own evidence.

inventory.label: Authentication and identity assertion
inventory.limitations: Secret Broker does not authenticate users and RFID identification is not authentication.

inventory.label: Customer and relationship management
inventory.limitations: CRM does not own cases, legal effects, banking balances or external principals.

inventory.label: Document creation and management
inventory.limitations: NotNotes owns document semantics, not arbitrary blob storage or legal effect.

inventory.label: Records retention, audit and evidentiary hold
inventory.limitations: Document semantics do not imply preservation of storage bytes or legal privilege.

inventory.label: Outbound and customer communications
inventory.limitations: External channel providers require separate evidence and contract qualification.

inventory.label: Legal obligations and legal-effect decisions
inventory.limitations: Institutional Policy can hold rules; it cannot issue legal conclusions or prove compliance.
